backend.title: Backend Instructions
body: Prefer framework-native patterns and existing abstractions.
Use parameterised queries or query builders for all database work.
Keep service boundaries explicit and dependency direction clean.

frontend.title: Frontend Instructions
body: Follow the existing design system before creating new patterns.
Keep state local unless shared state is clearly required.
Preserve accessibility, keyboard behaviour, and responsive layout.
Avoid broad visual rewrites unless explicitly requested.

tests.title: Test Instructions
body: Prefer behavioural assertions over implementation details.
Keep test data deterministic and readable.
Create or update the smallest failing test first for behaviour changes.
Re-run the smallest relevant test immediately after each substantive edit.
Do not weaken coverage by changing include/exclude scope.
